text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: estimate. Bar: interval from resampling whole months, at the level in brackets. Solid line: no difference. Dashed line: the +0.02 non-inferiority margin of C1. Data: 12 monthly refits, 2025-07 to 2026-06, lead days 1 to 10.'
text.tspan: Dot: estimate. Bar: interval from resampling whole months, at the level in brackets.
Solid line: no difference. Dashed line: the +0.02 non-inferiority margin of C1.
Data: 12 monthly refits, 2025-07 to 2026-06, lead days 1 to 10.
